subject.title: fix(transport): preserve HTTP status and Retry-After on Anthropic errors

question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109050 the sole landing path, or ask this PR to converge on the same status, lower-bound, and long-cooldown contract?
rationale: The branches solve the same reproduced bug but expose different shared metadata and retry/failover semantics; only one permanent contract should land.

options.title: Use the proven sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109050 as the canonical branch because it has live end-to-end proof and covers lower-bound and long-cooldown behavior.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR only if it carries HTTP status, preserves larger exponential delays, declines unsupported long waits, and adds equivalent real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Use the proven sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109050 as the canonical branch because it has live end-to-end proof and covers lower-bound and long-cooldown behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the provider transport and shared agent-message boundary affected by this contract decision.
